description: Step 1 of moving existing data (an SQLite file, a pb_data folder) onto the persistent volume of a service. Returns a dashboard page where the USER drops the file, and a one-hour upload link with a ready curl command for a shell on the machine that has the file; the bytes never pass through the model. A single file (app.db) is placed at a path of your choice, a .tar/.tar.gz archive replaces the whole volume. Pack a folder with its content at the top: tar -czf data.tar.gz -C pb_data . Then call runzero_import_volume with the importId.

bytes.description: Exact size of the file in bytes (e.g. from `wc -c < file`)

fileName.description: Name of the local file, e.g. app.db or pb_data.tar.gz

name: runzero_volume_import_link
title: Get volume import link
